briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.5%, S&P 500 -0.2%), showing no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold and per past lessons we don't force buys on neutral days just to fill open slots, so we're holding all 7 positions unchanged and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears rather than being spent just to feel active. On a neutral day like today, holding cash below the buy threshold and waiting is often smarter than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」(Dry Powder)是指保留現金,等待真正強勢的投資機會出現時再出手,而不是為了「有動作」而勉強交易。像今天這種中性行情,持有現金耐心等待,往往比勉強買進更明智。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted slightly lower today with no dominant catalyst, reflecting a quiet, indecisive session rather than any major shift in sentiment. Volume and price action across most of the screened candidates stayed muted compared to the volume-surge breakouts seen on stronger days. Without a clear directional trigger, mega-cap tech and the broader market largely traded sideways.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤指數小幅走低,NASDAQ跌0.5%、標普500跌0.2%,市場缺乏明顯的推動因素,呈現觀望氣氛。多數篩選股票的成交量與價格走勢都比較平淡,不像強勢日那樣出現放量突破。整體而言,大型科技股與大盤多維持橫盤整理格局。
